name: Hvm, Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hvm, Co.,Ltd. produces and sells special metals in Korea. The company offers special nickel alloy for use in parts of aircraft, turbines for power generation, ultra corrosive bolts and piping, and high-voltage transmission lines; stainless steel products for use in power generation turbine components, automobile gear, ship shafts, petrochemical device components, and others; and titanium alloys for use in power generation turbine components, guided weapon system components, aircraft propulsion/power engine and airframe components, implants, and electronic devices.
